Maya (PartnerEng): heads-up — Databricks product team wants a lightweight connector health contract for marketplace listing. they specifically asked for proactive telemetry, a health-check API, and a documented downgrade path when workspace quotas are hit.
Ethan (Infra Eng): can implement a /healthz plus a connector heartbeat pubsub. what do they mean by downgrade path?
Maya (PartnerEng): when heavy ingest spikes, marketplace should automatically fall back to reduced sampling mode (less frequent writes) and surface a banner in UI. Databricks wants the mechanism documented.
Leah (Product): reduced sampling mode sounds like a per-tenant policy. we should expose plan metadata and a transparent degrade severity levels: informational, rate-limit, sample-only, paused.
Ravi (Legal): legal note: marketplace listing will need a mutual SLA addendum. also require opt-out for telemetry for enterprise workspaces. avoid promises on customer-managed installs.
Tina (Field): customer ask — ability to whitelist certain critical tables from sampling. field teams will want a support workflow to request whitelists.
Ethan (Infra Eng): proposal: add endpoints and headers: 
- GET /v1/tenant/{id}/health -> "ok" | "degraded" with reason codes in header X-Connector-Status
- POST /v1/tenant/{id}/degrade -> body: {mode: "sample-only"} (signed by admin)
we'll emit events to telemetry topic connector.health.{tenant} for marketplace to subscribe.
Leah (Product): also include X-Connector-Plan and X-Degrade-Reason headers so UI can show a crisp message. include a machine-readable reason code set (e.g., quota_spike, infra_error, customer_toggle).
Maya (PartnerEng): Databricks also wants a short escalation matrix — who gets paged, SLA windows, and a contact for urgent whitelists.
Ravi (Legal): i'll prepare a templated addendum for marketplace listings with limited warranty, telemetry opt-out clause, and a reference to whitelisting support process.
Tina (Field): for whitelists, let's require a signed support request and a 48hr SLA to evaluate. that way we avoid ad-hoc changes.
Ethan (Infra Eng): operational notes: connector will support a per-tenant config file with: 
``` 
# tenant.conf
telemetry.enabled=true
whitelist.tables=["customers","orders"]
sampling.mode=auto
sampling.rate=0.1
```
we'll enforce sampling via token-bucket at ingest, emit 429 with Retry-After when sample-only mode and quota exceeded.
Leah (Product): product action: draft UI copy for banner states and a compact FAQ around whitelisting and degrade modes. Tina can review with field.
Maya (PartnerEng): i'll collate deliverables and share an external-facing one-page spec for Databricks by EOD tomorrow.
notify-bot: Calendar invite created: "Databricks connector health & degrade contract" 2025-06-10 16:00 UTC
Ravi (Legal): also flagging data residency concerns — any telemetry artifacts must be pseudonymized. i'll add that to the addendum.
Ethan (Infra Eng): action items: add health endpoints, implement heartbeat topic, per-tenant config, and 429 behavior. target PR by EOD.
Tina (Field): i'll draft the support runbook and the whitelist request template.
Maya (PartnerEng): thanks all. meeting tomorrow to review the one-pager and legal addendum. :rocket:
